description: BLIF receipt (#335) for temporal sweep suites rerun on the blif_circuit fixtures (FIXTURES) and the scripts/oracle/blif-circuit corpus. Both were compared against Evolution.
environment: macOS on Apple silicon, JDK 21.0.13 (Homebrew openjdk@21)

suites.command: FIXTURES='blif_circuit(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/default CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites default)
FIXTURES='blif_circuit(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --variants EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/variants CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites variants)

FIXTURES='blif_circuit(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --variants --negative EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/negative CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites negative)
FIXTURES='blif_circuit(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --pairs 6 EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/pairs CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites pairs)

ResaveDesktop WORK/variants/fixtures, then TemporalCorpusCli settle on each <id>.desktop.circ against the Evolution trace for the original (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites roundtrip)
scripts/oracle/blif-circuit/run.sh EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/corpus CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites corpus)
scripts/oracle/blif-circuit/run.sh EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/corpus CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify blif-circuit --suites corpus-roundtrip)
